mapper.select: SELECT it.category AS itemClass, it.item_name AS itemName, d.amount AS amount, d.expected_amount AS expectedAmount FROM yrt_header h JOIN yrt_detail d ON d.yrt_id = h.yrt_id JOIN yrt_item it ON it.yrt_item_id = d.yrt_item_id WHERE h.emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId}) AND h.base_year = #{baseYear} AND h.confirm_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY it.category, it.item_name

SELECT it.category AS itemClass, it.item_name AS itemName, d.amount AS amount, d.expected_amount AS expectedAmount FROM yrt_detail d JOIN yrt_item it ON it.yrt_item_id = d.yrt_item_id WHERE d.yrt_id = COALESCE(#{yrtId}, (SELECT yrt_id FROM ( SELECT h.yrt_id FROM yrt_header h WHERE h.emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId}) AND h.base_year = #{baseYear} AND h.confirm_yn = 'N' ORDER BY h.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1)) ORDER BY it.category, it.item_name

SELECT h.yrt_id AS yrtId, #{empId} AS empId, -- 화면 호환용(사번 echo) h.base_year AS baseYear, h.tax_apply_type AS runLabel, -- 임시: 실행라벨로 사용 h.confirm_yn AS confirmYn, h.created_at AS createdAt, h.created_at AS updatedAt FROM ( SELECT * FROM yrt_header WHERE emp_id = (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId}) AND base_year = #{baseYear} AND confirm_yn = 'Y' AND confirm_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC ) h WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT NVL(r.settle_income,0) AS addNational, NVL(r.settle_local ,0) AS addLocal FROM yrt_result_total r WHERE r.yrt_id = #{yrtId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_yrt.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO yrt_header ( yrt_id, emp_id, biz_place, base_year, tax_apply_type, tax_apply_result, confirm_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{yrtId}, (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.emp_no = #{empId}), '본사', #{baseYear}, #{runLabel}, NULL, 'N', SYSDATE )

MERGE INTO yrt_detail d USING ( SELECT #{yrtId} AS yrt_id, (SELECT it.yrt_item_id FROM yrt_item it WHERE it.category = #{cls} AND it.item_name = #{name} ) AS yrt_item_id, #{amt} AS amount, #{exp} AS expected_amount FROM dual ) s ON (d.yrt_id = s.yrt_id AND d.yrt_item_id = s.yrt_item_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET d.amount = s.amount, d.expected_amount = s.expected_amount WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (yrt_id, yrt_item_id, amount, expected_amount) VALUES (s.yrt_id, s.yrt_item_id, s.amount, s.expected_amount)

MERGE INTO yrt_result_total r USING (SELECT #{yrtId} AS yrt_id, #{nat} AS nat, #{loc} AS loc FROM dual) s ON (r.yrt_id = s.yrt_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET r.settle_income = s.nat, r.settle_local = s.loc, r.settle_total = s.nat + s.loc WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (yrt_id, settle_income, settle_local, settle_total) VALUES (s.yrt_id, s.nat, s.loc, s.nat + s.loc)
